gloss: unexpectedly; suddenly; out of the blue

definitions.gloss: unexpectedly; suddenly; out of the blue
definitions.explanation: Describes something that happens without warning or preparation, catching someone off guard.

examples.japanese: {不意|ふい}に⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれた→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: My name was called out of the blue.

examples.japanese: {不意|ふい}に⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}した→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧。
examples.english: I suddenly remembered something from the past.

examples.japanese: ⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{不意|ふい}に⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}り{出|だ}して→降り出す：03004_furidasu⟧、⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{濡|ぬ}れて→濡れる：00800_nureru⟧しまった。
examples.english: During my walk it suddenly started raining, and without an umbrella I got soaked.

notes:
USAGE:
The base form ⟦{不意|ふい}→不意：11351_fui⟧ is also used in the expression ⟦{不意|ふい}→不意：11351_fui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{突|つ}く→突く：12735_tsuku⟧ (to catch off guard, to take by surprise). {不意|ふい}に as an adverb describes unexpected events that happen to the speaker.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不意|ふい}に⟦{現|あらわ}れる→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧ (to appear suddenly)
- ⟦{不意|ふい}→不意：11351_fui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{突|つ}く→突く：12735_tsuku⟧ (to catch off guard)
- ⟦{不意|ふい}→不意：11351_fui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{来客|らいきゃく}→来客：13061_raikyaku⟧ (an unexpected visitor)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧ is more emphatic and dramatic
- ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ emphasizes speed
- {不意|ふい}に emphasizes the element of surprise
